rows.note: Use this specifically when someone arrives or does something at the scheduled time.

example.english: They are always prompt and never make anyone wait.
example.traditional: 佢次次都準時到，從來唔使人等。
example.jyutping: keoi5 ci3 ci3 dou1 zeon2 si4 dou3 cung4 loi4 m4 sai2 jan4 dang2

rows.note: Use this all-purpose choice for giving someone a cue or asking a computer user to provide input.

example.english: The teacher gave me a prompt about which angle to take in answering this question.
example.traditional: 老師提示我可以從邊方面答呢條題目。
example.jyutping: lou5 si1 tai4 si6 ngo5 ho2 ji5 cung4 bin1 fong1 min6 daap3 ne1 tiu4 tai4 muk6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for someone who acts quickly without dragging their feet.

example.english: You’re really prompt—you finished the report so quickly.
example.traditional: 你做嘢真係快手，咁快就整好份報告。
example.jyutping: nei5 zou6 je5 zan1 hai6 faai3 sau2 gam3 faai3 zau6 zing2 hou2 fan6 bou3 gou3

rows.note: Use this for text instructions given to an AI model to generate an answer or image.

example.english: We entered a prompt asking the model to generate a picture of a sunset by the sea.
example.traditional: 我哋輸入咗一段提示詞，叫個模型生成一張海邊日落嘅相。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 syu1 jap6 zo2 jat1 dyun6 tai4 si6 ci4 giu3 go3 mou4 jing4 sang1 sing4 jat1 zoeng1 hoi2 bin1 jat6 lok6 ge3 soeng2

rows.note: Use this technical term for the characters showing that a computer is ready for input.

example.english: Once the prompt appears on the screen, you can enter a command.
example.traditional: 見到畫面出現提示字元，就可以打指令喇。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 waa2 min2 ceot1 jin6 tai4 si6 zi6 jyun4 zau6 ho2 ji5 daa2 zi2 ling6 laa3

rows.note: Use this for the words supplied to an actor who has forgotten their lines.

example.english: The actor forgot a line, so the prompter immediately gave them a prompt.
example.traditional: 演員一時唔記得對白，場邊即刻畀咗句提詞佢。
example.jyutping: jin2 jyun4 jat1 si4 m4 gei3 dak1 deoi3 baak6 coeng4 bin1 zik1 hak1 bei2 zo2 geoi3 tai4 ci4 keoi5

rows.note: Use this when prompting means motivating or causing someone to do something.

example.english: This failure can prompt us to rethink the whole plan.
example.traditional: 今次失敗促使我重新諗過成個計劃。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 sat1 baai6 cuk1 si2 ngo5 cung4 san1 nam2 gwo3 seng4 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this technical phrase when supplying written input to an AI system to obtain a particular output.

example.english: I prompt the artificial intelligence with a written instruction to write some ad copy.
example.traditional: 我會先輸入提示詞，叫人工智能寫一段廣告文案。
example.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 sin1 syu1 jap6 tai4 si6 ci4 giu3 jan4 gung1 zi3 nang4 se2 jat1 dyun6 gwong2 gou3 man4 on3
